definitions.explanation: The act of measuring body temperature, typically with a thermometer. Became an everyday term during the COVID-19 pandemic when temperature checks were required at building entrances.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{検温|けんおん}する。
examples.english: To take one's temperature every morning.

examples.japanese: {入口|いりぐち}で{検温|けんおん}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please have your temperature checked at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}では{毎日|まいにち}{検温|けんおん}の{結果|けっか}を{記録|きろく}することになっている。
examples.english: At school, we are required to record the results of our daily temperature checks.

notes:
{検温|けんおん} is the act of measuring body temperature, typically with a thermometer. The word became part of everyday vocabulary during the COVID-19 pandemic.

FORMS:
{検|けん} (examine) + {温|おん} (temperature)

USAGE:
Used as a する verb: {検温|けんおん}する (to take someone's temperature). Common in medical, school, and workplace settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検温|けんおん}する: to take a temperature reading
- {検温|けんおん}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct temperature checks (formal)
- {検温|けんおん}{結果|けっか}: temperature check results

RELATED WORDS:
- {体温|たいおん}: body temperature
- {体温計|たいおんけい}: thermometer
- {発熱|はつねつ}: fever
- {平熱|へいねつ}: normal body temperature
